source: Actual isolated authenticated PostgreSQL wheel v4 receipts (owner rulings 2026-09-21, R2/R12/R13/R15/R18): four hundred real paid spins plus the forced captures in tests/sql/diamond-wheel-v4-draw-and-cards.sql, read from that probe's own WHEEL_SAMPLE notices while scripts/dev/test-accounting-delivery.sh ran it. Every public and auth row is rolled back and every seed is synthetic and test-only.
how_to_regenerate: flock /var/tmp/pgwork/harness.lock -c 'su postgres -c "cd <worktree> && TMPDIR=/var/tmp/pgwork PG_BIN=/usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin bash scripts/dev/test-accounting-delivery.sh"' 2>&1 | grep 'WHEEL_SAMPLE {"kind": "wheel-v4-', keep the JSON after each marker and sort the records by kind. The probe's seeds are fixed, so the same chain draws the same ords, rolls, weights and prizes every time; the row ids and the timestamps are fresh on each run, because they are gen_random_uuid() and transaction_timestamp().
